{{CharInfobox |color={{water color}} |corecolor={{water color light}} |bordercolor={{water color dark}} |name=Ida |jname=イア |tmname=Ia |image=Ida.png |size=250px |caption=Ida |gender=Female |hometown=[[Seafolk Village]] |region=[[Alola]] |anime=yes |epnum=SM040 |epname=Balloons, Brionne, and Belligerence! |enva=[[Caroline Spinola]] |java=[[Rie Kugimiya]] }} '''Ida''' (Japanese: '''イア''' ''Ia'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|SM}}. Ida and her boyfriend [[Kanoa]] belong to the Seafolk, a group of people who travel around the seas of the world. ==History== Despite Kanoa's best efforts to find treasure, in order to make an income, Ida performed on the streets with her {{p|Brionne}} in ''[[SM040|Balloons, Brionne, and Belligerence!]]''. While performing in [[Hau'oli City]], she met up with {{Ash}}, {{an|Lana}}, and {{an|Mallow}}. After seeing Ida and Brionne perform {{m|Hydro Vortex}}, Lana asked Ida to teach her how to use the [[Z-Move]], as she had trouble executing it herself. Ida agreed to tutor Lana and her {{TP|Lana|Popplio}} and the training went on for days while Kanoa continued to search for treasure. Kanoa eventually discovered that a [[Mystic Water]] could be found in a sunken ship off the coast of [[Melemele Island]]. They all went to search for it, but found out the sunken ship was protected by a wild {{p|Dhelmise}}. Kanoa eventually retrieved it with the help of Lana, who had scared away the Dhelmise with her Popplio's newly-perfected Hydro Vortex. He later gave the Mystic Water to Ida as a necklace. Ida and Kanoa said their goodbyes to Ash, Lana and Mallow, with Ida promising to meet up with Lana again to see how much she has progressed. They then set off on their boat, on to their next destination. In ''[[SM104|That's Some Spicy Island Research!]]'', Lana revealed that she and Ida had been keeping in contact with each other by writing letters. Lana also referred to Ida as her master, and was revealed to have arranged a meeting with her at [[Seafolk Village]] to learn more from her. Ida and Kanoa finally arrived at Seafolk Village in ''[[SM106|Evolving Research!]]'', where she was immediately greeted by Lana. After showing off her newly evolved {{p|Primarina}}, Ida revealed she would already depart the next day, but promised Lana to train with her. During a farewell party for her and Kanoa, Ida and Primarina displayed Primarina's exclusive Z-Move, {{m|Oceanic Operetta}}, inspiring Lana to do more training. The next morning, before her departure, Ida witnessed Lana's Popplio evolve into Brionne, after which she handed Lana a [[Primarium Z]]. ==Character== Ida is shown to be a talented musician in ''[[SM040|Balloons, Brionne, and Belligerence!]]'', where she able to attract a large audience. When {{an|Lana}} approached her, asking to be her apprentice, Ida was taken aback but with encouragement from [[Kanoa]], Ida agreed to do it. With Ida's teaching, Lana and {{TP|Lana|Popplio}} were able to master {{m|Hydro Vortex}}. This led Ida and Lana to keep in touch, as revealed in ''[[SM104|That's Some Spicy Island Research!]]'', where Lana was said to send Ida letters that Ida would always reply to. This friendship has led Lana to refer to Ida as her master. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Ida's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ida |pkmn=Primarina |stage1=Brionne |type1=Water |type2=Fairy |img=Ida Brionne.png |img2=Ida Primarina.png |epnum=SM040 |epname=Balloons, Brionne, and Belligerence! |vajp=Chinami Nishimura |vaen=Eileen Stevens |desc={{p|Primarina}} is Ida's only known Pokémon. As a {{p|Brionne}}, it was first used as part of a show and used {{m|Hydro Vortex}} underneath [[Kanoa]], who was standing on a surfboard. When Ida agreed to help {{an|Lana}}, Brionne set up three of its balloons so that [[Lana's Popplio]] can practice its own balloons, which kept popping on contact with Brionne's. Brionne later created a big balloon that allowed Kanoa to go underwater so he could search for a [[Mystic Water]] meant for Ida. When the ship got attacked by {{p|Dhelmise}}, Brionne attempted to stop it, only to be knocked out. In ''[[SM106|Evolving Research!]]'', it was revealed to have evolved into Primarina. During the episode, it spend the day training with Lana's Popplio. Later, it and Ida performed Primarina's exclusive [[Z-Move]], {{m|Oceanic Operetta}}. Similar to Lana's Brionne, Primarina is able to make water balloons of varying size and color. Primarina's known moves are {{m|Aqua Jet}} and {{m|Sparkling Aria}}{{tt|*|Never used, confirmed through the use of its exclusive Z-Move}}.
